description: This file contains a stock balance report implementation for ERPNext, including functions to fetch stock ledger entries, compute item and warehouse data, and generate report columns and data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate stock balance report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Returns the list of columns for the report, optionally including stock ageing and variant attributes.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters for fetching stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries from the database based on filters and item list.

methods.name: get_item_warehouse_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of item quantities and values per warehouse and company from stock ledger entries.

methods.name: filter_items_with_no_transactions
methods.description: Removes items with no transactions from the item-warehouse map.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves list of items based on item code, group, or brand filters.

methods.name: get_item_details
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for items, including variant attributes if requested.

methods.name: get_item_reorder_details
methods.description: Fetches reorder level and quantity details for items.

methods.name: get_variants_attributes
methods.description: Returns all item variant attribute names.

methods.name: get_variant_values_for
methods.description: Retrieves variant attribute values for a list of items.
